title: Quicktake: Holiday shoppers consider AI agents for deal hunting
summary: Making smart, well-informed decisions is the key to financial freedom. We hope these great tips will enhance your shopping experiences.
body_markdown:
[Back to Insights & Innovation](https://newsroom.breadfinancial.com/insights-innovation) Survey


October 6, 2026


# Quicktake: Holiday shoppers consider AI agents for deal hunting


[Learn more about working with Bread Financial](https://www.breadfinancial.com/en/business-solutions.html)


69% of holiday shoppers are considering AI agents or tools for price comparisons and deal-hunting this season


The majority of shoppers are excited ( **19%**


), curious ( **22%**


) or open, but cautious ( **21%**


) about the potential for using AI agents or tools during the holiday season. While scouting deals is at the top of their wish lists for AI assistance, shoppers are also considering the other ways AI might make them look like thoughtful gift-givers—with the proper precautions.


Deal-hunting drives excitement


Shoppers have been honing their deal-hunting skills for years, but AI could level up their game. Seven in ten ( **69%**


) are likely to use an AI agent or tool this holiday season to compare prices or find deals—a share that climbs among younger cohorts but, notably, still reaches half of boomers.


**Very/somewhat likely to use AI agents or tools to compare prices or find deals**
*Holiday shoppers, by generation*


Image


Curiosity extends to gifting


While holiday shoppers are homing in on AI’s potential to save money, they are also interested in seeing how these agents or tools might improve their gift-giving prowess


**Strongly agree/agree about AI agents or tools (select responses)**
*Among total holiday shoppers*


Image


But caution still sets the limits


Despite its potential, holiday shoppers seem most comfortable using AI agents with pre-purchase activities, placing high importance on oversight of final decisions and protecting personal data. This sentiment is steady across generations.


**Very/somewhat important guardrails for AI agents when holiday shopping**
*Among total holiday shoppers*


Image


Key takeaway: Shoppers want AI on the price tag, not the gift tag


Holiday shoppers are ready to let AI hunt deals — but they want the final call to stay human. Retailers that offer transparent, permission-based AI experiences with clear data protections will earn both trust and conversion.


*Source: Bread Financial Agentic AI + Holidays survey, Aug-26*
